9.name: Elena finds Tom at harbor
9.description: Elena locates Tom on the dock while he watches a fishing vessel unload, setting up their conversation.
evidence: Elena finds TOM on the dock, watching a fishing vessel unload.

9.name: Elena follows up with Tom
9.description: Elena approaches Tom to continue her inquiry, indicating an ongoing investigation or interview.
evidence:
ELENA
Chief Briggs. I wanted to follow up.

TOM
Chief's generous. What's on your mind?

9.name: Elena asks lighthouse construction date
9.description: Elena questions Tom about when the lighthouse was built.
evidence:
ELENA
The lighthouse. Can you confirm when it was built?

9.name: Tom dates lighthouse to 1923
9.description: Tom states that the lighthouse was built in 1923 as part of a coastal modernization program involving six towers.
evidence:
TOM
(leaning on a post)
1923, wasn't it. Part of the coastal modernization program. Six towers built that year along this stretch.

9.name: Elena records Tom's answer
9.description: Elena carefully writes down Tom's information about the lighthouse.

9.name: Elena asks about Marcus personally
9.description: Elena shifts her questioning from the lighthouse to Marcus himself.

9.name: Tom says Marcus has excellent eyesight
9.description: Tom describes Marcus as sharp and says he has never needed glasses and can read tide charts from across the room.
evidence:
TOM
Good man. Sharp. Never needed glasses a day in his life, from what I know. Can still read the tide charts from across the room without squinting.

9.name: Elena reacts and slows note-taking
9.description: Elena's pen slows after hearing Tom's statement about Marcus's eyesight, signaling the information matters to her.

9.name: Anchor runs to Tom
9.description: A golden retriever bounds down the dock and circles Tom's legs.
evidence: A GOLDEN RETRIEVER comes bounding down the dock, circling Tom's legs.

9.name: Tom identifies dog as Marcus's
9.description: Tom identifies the dog as Anchor and infers that Marcus walked him down that morning.
evidence:
TOM
That's Anchor. Marcus must have walked him down this morning.

9.name: Marcus appears on dock
9.description: Marcus arrives at the far end of the dock, and the dog leaps at his hands, confirming his presence nearby.
evidence: Marcus appears at the far end of the dock, the golden retriever leaping at his hands.

9.name: Marcus calls out to Elena
9.description: Marcus addresses Elena from down the dock and asks whether she is finished.

9.name: Elena notes Marcus after seeing him
9.description: Elena watches the dog with Marcus and adds another note to her legal pad, suggesting she is connecting this observation to her inquiry.
evidence: Elena watches the golden retriever and adds a note to her yellow legal pad.
